answer: Delayed topic-spiral clustering.** Each agent's transaction graph is scored for an atypical spiral of repeated counterparties within a short window; clusters whose internal cohesion exceeds a threshold while external diversity stays low are flagged retroactively. Flagged identities must post a fresh, independent deposit into a shared vault before further participation, forfeited if the cluster recurs. An attacker's cost is rebuilding a plausible external-diversity haven for every identity, since one shared deposit cannot cover many accounts.
